Raw materials we handle

We know what arrives at your door.

High-quality pet food is often made from raw materials that are hard to handle, from MDM to vegetables such as spinach. We tailor the line to your recipes and raw materials.

Mechanically separated meatMDM
Crushed and finely groundBones

The same standard as food

Pet food is not a lower standard.

It is a common misconception. A modern pet food line needs exactly the same machinery and hygiene standard as a food line. Your raw material is demanding, your machines are powerful, and everything is washed every day.

Washed every day.

Every machine is designed to be cleaned easily, without risk to the people who wash it.

Safe during washdown

Every delivery is risk-assessed and CE‑marked. Standstill monitors keep rotating parts still while they are washed and serviced.

Nothing on the floor

Raw material stays in the process, not on the floor, so more of every kilo ends up in your product.

No metal in the grinder

One metal object in a fine grinder can break blades and hole plates worth several thousand euros. Metal detection is built into the line.

Fewer boots on the floor

Automated transfers remove heavy, dangerous lifts. Capacity goes up, quality evens out and your people are spared.

The line

From reception to plate freezer. One line, one team.

Every station opens the machines behind it. We build the whole material flow or the one station you are missing.

Crushing

Frozen blocks and bones are crushed.

The single shaft CombiBreaker Mini Titan breaks frozen blocks and crushes all kinds of bones. Feed and discharge are built for a hoist or a conveyor.

5 t/hfrozen blocks
9 t/hbones, with the 18.5 kW motor
Titan Series →
03Station 03

Conveying

Screw and belt conveyors move the raw material.

Belt conveyors in stainless steel from 0.25 to 11 kW, with scrapers, filling and discharge hoppers, and adjustable height and speed as options.

Screw Conveyors →Belt Conveyors →

Mixing, cooling or heating

Large mixers, with CO2 cooling or steam heating when needed.

The closed CMX mixer cools with CO2 while it mixes, and direct steam injection heats the raw material. Shown: CMX 3000 with twin shafts, a sliding lid and four CO2 nozzles.

3,000 lCMX 3000

Metal detection

A metal detector protects the process before the grinders.

Pumping and plate freezing

Plate freezing for pet food

Especially suited to MDM, pet food and by-products.

Freezing raw material into blocks is a cost- and energy-efficient method for large volumes. We automate the filling, unloading and palletising around the plate freezers, so your people do not have to empty them by hand.

Manual stackingSemi-automaticFully automatic
AutomatedLoading
AutomatedFreezing
AutomatedUnloading
AutomatedPalletising

Pump filling is recommended for minced material. Payback for a new automated line is often 2 to 5 years.
